item.title: The Government Uses Targeted Advertising to Track Your Location
item.description:
📝 " At the same time, we know that federal law enforcement agencies have been buying up our location data from shady data brokers that most people have never heard of. They rely on the multi-billion-dollar data broker industry to buy location data harvested from people’s smartphones. Data brokers can collect location data from SDKs that they pay developers to put in their apps.
🔗 Read more: https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/03/targeted-advertising-gives-your-location-government-just-ask-cbp
